/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import re, pathlib, collections
root=pathlib.Path('.')
files=list(root.glob('**/src/main/java/**/*.java'))
# remove comments and strings for token analysis

def clean(s):
    s=re.sub(r'/\\*.*?\\*/',' ',s,flags=re.S)
    s=re.sub(r'//.*',' ',s)
    s=re.sub(r'\"(?:\\\\.|["'^"'"\\\\])*\"',' ',s)
    s=re.sub(r\"'(?:\\\\.|["'^'"'\\\\])*'\",' ',s)
    return s
nodes={}; by_simple=collections.defaultdict(list)
for p in files:
    raw=p.read_text(errors='ignore'); s=clean(raw)
    pm=re.search(r'\\bpackage\\s+([\\w.]+)\\s*;',s)
    pkg=pm.group(1) if pm else ''
    # first top-level-ish type; sufficient outer class name
    tm=re.search(r'\\b(?:class|interface|enum|record)\\s+(\\w+)',s)
    if not tm: continue
    name=tm.group(1); fq=pkg+'.'+name
    imports={m.group(2):m.group(1) for m in re.finditer(r'\\bimport\\s+(?:static\\s+)?([\\w.]+)\\.(\\w+)\\s*;',s) for _ in [0]}
    nodes[fq]=(p,s,pkg,name,imports)
    by_simple[name].append(fq)
# resolve known names per file based imports/package, then references by token
edges=collections.defaultdict(set)
for fq,(p,s,pkg,name,imports) in nodes.items():
    for simple, candidates in by_simple.items():
        if simple==name: continue
        if not re.search(r'\\b'+re.escape(simple)+r'\\b',s): continue
        resolved=None
        if simple in imports: resolved=imports[simple]
        elif pkg+'.'+simple in candidates: resolved=pkg+'.'+simple
        elif len(candidates)==1: resolved=candidates[0]
        # Wildcards / same-package uncommon; for ambiguity, include candidate if imported exact
        if resolved in nodes and resolved"'!=fq: edges[fq].add(resolved)
# closures for target simple names
for target in ['"'CustomerService','ProductService','PricingService','UserFacade','StoreFacade','EmailService','CountryService','OrderFacade']:
    ts=[x for x in nodes if x.rsplit('.',1)[-1]==target]
    affected=set(ts); changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        for a,bs in edges.items():
            if a not in affected and bs & affected:
                affected.add(a); changed=True
    print('\\nTARGET',target)
    print('direct/closure',len(affected))
    for a in sorted(affected):
        p,s,pkg,n,im=nodes[a]
        if '@RestController' in s or '@Controller' in s:
            print(' CONTROLLER',n, p)
    if target=='OrderFacade':
        for a in sorted(affected): print(' ',a)
